steps: Take the marinated chicken out of the fridge so it is not ice cold when it cooks.
Fry the onion in a little of the butter until soft, then blend it with the tomatoes until smooth.
Melt more butter and fry the ginger, garlic and green chilli for a minute.
Stir in the chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin and garam masala, then pour in the tomato purée.
Cook the sauce on medium until thick and the butter shows at the edges, then add a cup of hot water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Sear the chicken in a hot pan until just cooked, then add it to the sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the salt, sugar and crushed kasuri methi.
Turn off the heat, swirl in the cream and scatter the coriander leaves.
note: Fresh tomato follows the source that uses 600 g for four; the other uses a can, which works out lighter. Only a small squeeze of lemon goes into the marinade, so half a lemon covers it.
